content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Mainly homeowners and condo property insurance for individuals, not specialty commercial coverage for small and mid-sized businesses."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Specialty commercial property and casualty underwriting through agents and brokers matches the target, though it also runs annuities."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Annuities, life insurance and retirement plan administration serve savers and employers, not commercial property and casualty buyers."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Online health and Medicare insurance marketplace earning carrier commissions; it does not underwrite business risk."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Fixed and indexed annuities and life insurance sold to individuals for retirement, a different product and customer base."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Underwrites commercial property and liability for small businesses and contractors through independent agents, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Primarily title insurance and mortgage guaranty for homebuyers and lenders; its general commercial lines are a secondary part."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Specialty commercial property, inland marine and excess and surplus lines sold through agents and wholesale brokers closely match the target."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Life insurance, residential mortgage lending and cemetery operations serve individual families, not business property and casualty coverage."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage and program administration earning commissions, rather than underwriting and bearing risk on its own balance sheet."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Commercial multiple peril and specialty commercial insurance for small and mid-sized businesses through independent agents matches the target, alongside personal lines."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Specialty commercial property and casualty underwriting sold through independent agents and wholesale brokers closely matches the target."}]}
